question: Cause of the long 20-38 s waits near roundabout 19,9 in replay v20 (handoff step 5)
scenario: docs/training/full-replay-review-2026-11-08/measurements/replay-candidate-v20.json (strict, no grants); diagnostic wall cap raised to 900 s

unfixed_77_and_78_source.result: game-over 1185.95 s, 586 trips, 340/406 events (identical to the handoff's 75-suite run)
unfixed_77_and_78_source.long_waits: all waits over 20 s begin after t=1145 on the approaches/ring around 19,7, 19,8, 20,9, 18,9
unfixed_77_and_78_source.deadlock_definition: greatest set of stopped cars (speed<0.02) each held by a member, where held = queue gap, conflicting occupant, or approach priority recomputed exactly as MayEnter
unfixed_77_and_78_source.roundabout: center 19,9; ring 19,8, 18,9, 19,10, 20,9; junction 19,7 north of ring cell 19,8
unfixed_77_and_78_source.game_over_cause: red shared destination 35 at 11,18 overcrowded from about t=1116 (50.01 s at 1185.95), before the deadlock formed; the deadlock did not cause this game-over

cause: Approach priority (MayEnter comparator) was granted to car 6, which could not enter junction 19,7 because car 52 was stopped inside it on a conflicting lane. Cars 28/22 leaving the ring northward yielded to car 6 although their exit lane does not conflict with car 52; car 22 therefore occupied the ring lane car 15 needed; car 15 held car 52 in the junction. Each car waits for the next permanently.
broad_candidate: Skip priority of any car whose target is occupied by a conflicting vehicle: v20 game-over 1104.3 s, 492 trips, no deadlock. Rejected as too broad (also overrides priority behind normal moving cross traffic).
adopted_fix: Skip priority only when the conflicting occupant is stationary (speed<0.02, the waiting threshold). v20: game-over 1176.95 s, 580 trips, no deadlock at any second. First divergence from the unfixed run at t=1007.65 (car 14 near 26,15 no longer yields to a car held by a stationary vehicle); later differences are chaotic divergence, not a measured quality signal. The v20 score is not a fidelity target.
regression: SimulationChecks 'blocked approach priority cannot deadlock a junction beside a roundabout' (five cars at the measured v20 lane offsets): fails on the unfixed engine (all five stuck after 60 s), passes with the fix. A four-car version without the car ahead of D passed on the unfixed engine and was not used.
checks_after_fix: 79 core suites, reward v5 6/6, environment 7/7, five-map 10 runs PASS
